completed_tasks.title: Migrate to AGP 9.0.1
completed_tasks.description: Updated Android Gradle Plugin to 9.0.1 and resolved all breaking changes
changes: Updated agp to 9.0.1
Removed kotlin-android plugin (no longer required since AGP 9.0)
Removed kotlin-compose plugin (built-in since AGP 9.0)
Removed kotlin-kapt plugin (not compatible with AGP 9.0 built-in Kotlin)
Removed kotlin-android and kotlin-kapt from project-level build.gradle.kts
Updated compileSdk to 36
Fixed ndkVersion by removing rc suffix
Fixed languageVersion from KOTLIN_2_2 to KOTLIN_2_1
Updated Java version from 11 to 17

completed_tasks.title: Migrate from kapt to KSP
completed_tasks.description: Replaced all kapt dependencies with KSP for better performance and AGP 9.0 compatibility
changes: Replaced kapt(libs.hilt.compiler) with ksp(libs.hilt.compiler)
Replaced kaptAndroidTest(libs.hilt.compiler) with kspAndroidTest(libs.hilt.compiler)
Updated KSP version to 2.3.1 (first version compatible with AGP 9.0)
Fixed hilt-android library declaration (was using plugin syntax instead of library syntax)
Removed kotlin('kapt') plugin from app/build.gradle.kts
Added android.disallowKotlinSourceSets=false to gradle.properties

completed_tasks.title: Fix hiltViewModel Import
completed_tasks.description: Updated all hiltViewModel imports to use the correct non-deprecated package
changes: Replaced deprecated import androidx.hilt.lifecycle.viewmodel.compose.hiltViewModel
Updated to androidx.hilt.navigation.compose.hiltViewModel
Downgraded hilt-navigation-compose to 1.2.0 to fix deprecation warning

completed_tasks.title: Fix CategoriesScreen Crash (Nested Scroll)
completed_tasks.description: Fixed IllegalStateException caused by LazyColumn inside AdaptiveColumn with verticalScroll
changes: Removed AdaptiveColumn wrapper that was causing nested scroll conflict
Replaced with LazyColumn directly inside AdaptiveContainer
Added fillMaxSize() modifier to LazyColumn
Improved ResponsiveCategoryItem with Card wrapper for better UI
Added description field display in category items
Fixed import from deprecated hiltViewModel package

completed_tasks.title: Fix AccountSecurityScreen Crash (Nested Scroll)
completed_tasks.description: Fixed IllegalStateException caused by verticalScroll inside AdaptiveColumn inside AdaptiveFormContainer
changes: Removed AdaptiveColumn and AdaptiveFormContainer wrappers
Replaced with single Column with verticalScroll directly inside AdaptiveContainer
Added horizontal padding to Column instead of nested containers
Maintained all 2FA, biometric, and password change functionality
Fixed import from deprecated hiltViewModel package

completed_tasks.title: Fix Biometric 'FragmentActivity not found' Error
completed_tasks.description: Fixed biometric authentication failure caused by MainActivity inheriting from ComponentActivity instead of AppCompatActivity
changes: Changed MainActivity to inherit from AppCompatActivity instead of ComponentActivity
Added androidx.appcompat:appcompat:1.7.0 dependency
Added appcompat version and library entry in libs.versions.toml
AppCompatActivity extends FragmentActivity which BiometricPrompt requires
LocalActivity.current as? FragmentActivity now returns correctly

completed_tasks.title: Setup Clean Public GitHub Repository
completed_tasks.description: Created a clean public GitHub repository with proper .gitignore and no sensitive files
changes: Created comprehensive .gitignore covering Android, secrets, generated files
Added .kotlin/, .vscode/, .firebaserc to .gitignore
Added app/release/ to .gitignore
Removed gradle-wrapper.jar from tracking
Removed app-release.aab from git tracking
Verified no API keys or secrets in tracked files
Initialized fresh git repository with clean history
Added proper GitHub repository topics and description
Pushed to https://github.com/kareem2099/DotReminder.git

completed_tasks.title: Implement Real Active Sessions Feature
completed_tasks.description: Replaced mock sessions with real Firestore-backed session tracking including save, display, and sign out
changes: Created Session.kt model with deviceName, deviceModel, loginTime, lastActive fields
Created SessionRepository.kt with Firestore CRUD operations and real-time Flow
Created ActiveSessionsViewModel.kt with loadSessions, signOutSession, signOutAllOtherSessions
Replaced mock ActiveSessionsScreen with real UI showing live Firestore sessions
Added CURRENT_SESSION_ID key to UserPreferencesRepository DataStore
Added provideSessionRepository() to AppModule
Added SessionRepository dependency to AuthViewModel constructor
Added saveSession() function called after every successful login (email, Google, Facebook)
Sessions stored under users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId} in Firestore
Fixed Firestore Rules to allow read/write on sessions subcollection
Current device highlighted with primaryContainer color and 'This device' badge
Sign Out button disabled for current session
Sign Out All Other Devices button disabled when only one session exists

key_breaking_changes: kapt replaced with ksp for all annotation processing
